summary_1line: Nimi becomes the blinking of all eyes and from his body arises Mithi, after which Rama begins the tale leading to Shukra’s curse on Yayati.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rishis vigorously churn the preserved body of King Nimi with sacred chants, and from it the ascetic Mithi suddenly arises.
The gods declare that Nimi will dwell in the blinking of all creatures’ eyes as a subtle spirit moving like air.
Devayani, distraught and weeping beside her son Yadu, calls upon her father Shukra in anger and despair.
